recipe: 2-member ensemble (daily change averaged per step) of residual U-Nets: 1-step then multi-step (2,4,8) fine-tune, gradient-magnitude anti-blur loss 0.3
doy_convention: export takes doy of the predicted day (WEIGHTS.md); net trained on last-input-day doy, wrapper shifts by -1 day
post_processing: post.npz fitted on 2005-2018: climatology blend per lead (capped at 0.5) + rain quantile map per lead (segment slope capped at 1.5); applied by root twin.py via postproc.py to the finished rollout
